item.title: Welcome
item.description: Get started # AppservR can be downloaded from GitHub (pick a download option for the latest release for your platform). Download → Download Our one-page Quick Start tutorial will help you get started. Quick Start → Go further # Get instructions on how to accomplish common tasks with AppservR. Recipes → Contributing # We welcome very much contributions and feedback on this project. Please feel free to contribute, starting by opening an issue on GitHub to report a bug or discuss features.

item.title: Quick Start
item.description: Requirements # AppservR runs your Shiny apps using your system installation of R. You need to have R installed on your system to use it. You will also need the shiny package and all other R packages your apps need. Learn more about Shiny → 💡 Make sure first that you are able to run your Shiny app properly using R/Rstudio to check that all required packages are installed. AppservR itself ships as prebuilt binaries for Windows (32 and 64-bit) and Linux (64-bit).
